lines.speaker: policeman01
lines.text: Nikkephobic activists disrupted the speech

lines.speaker: policeman01
lines.text: and tried to force their way onto the stage.

lines.speaker: policeman01
lines.text: Your daughter got caught in the scuffle and fell near the edge of the stairs,

lines.speaker: policeman01
lines.text: breaking her neck and severing her nerves.

lines.speaker: policeman01
lines.text: She is conscious but cannot speak or move.
Oswald listens quietly to the police officer's dry, emotionless explanation.
His eyes meet Freesia's, but he can't hold her gaze and looks away.

lines.speaker: policeman01
lines.text: It appears your daughter previously signed a consent form for posthumous Nikke conversion.

lines.speaker: policeman01
lines.text: In special cases like this, conversion can be done even while she's still alive,

lines.speaker: policeman01
lines.text: but the decision rests with the legal guardian.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Is there any chance of recovery?

lines.speaker: policeman01
lines.text: According to the doctor, there's no chance of recovery.

lines.speaker: policeman01
lines.text: They say miraculous recoveries do happen, but outside of that, improvement is impossible.

lines.speaker: policeman01
lines.text: I see you've held a senior position in the Central Government for quite some time.

lines.speaker: policeman01
lines.text: That gives her a significant advantage during the conversion process. You'd also be able to choose the manufacturer.

lines.speaker: policeman01
lines.text: If she's not going to be a mass-produced unit, you can even choose which squad she'll be assigned to.

lines.speaker: policeman01
lines.text: How would you like to proceed?

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: I'll need some time to think this through.

lines.speaker: policeman01
lines.text: Understood. How long should we wait?

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: I'll contact you directly.

lines.speaker: policeman01
lines.text: Noted.

lines.speaker: policeman01
lines.text: Please be aware that we can't be reached by phone on the weekends.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Got it.
The police officer steps out of the hospital room,
leaving behind only the beeps and whirs of machines.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: ... Freesia,

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: do you want to become a Nikke?
Freesia blinks.
Silence hangs in the air.
After staring at Freesia for a long while, Oswald finally speaks.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: I don't want that.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: I can't bear the thought of you forgetting me.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Promise me you won't forget me.
Freesia blinks, tears streaming down her cheeks.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: ... All right,

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: until next time.
Freesia blinks,
and Oswald reaches for his phone.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: EEEEEEEEEntertainment!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: VIPs of the Ark, mes amis!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Enjoying yourselves, oui?
Soft murmurs ripple through the audience.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Oh là là, barely a whisper!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Tell me, did le spectacle tickle your fancy, mes chers?
The audience erupts in cheers.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Et voilà! Today's extravaganza draws to a close.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Take care on your way home, mes chers!
People are filing out, their footsteps fading into silence.
Mustang watches until the last audience member disappears, then makes his way backstage.
A staffer hands him a drink. He sips casually, then flings the remainder across their face.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Tsk, get the sweetness right. I won't repeat myself.
Mustang enters the monitor room
and sinks into an extravagant single-seat sofa that looks completely out of place.
A handful of staff rush to his side, touching up his makeup, spritzing perfume, and fixing his hair.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Which genius handled the lighting today?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: That'd be Richard.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Fire him. That glare's unbearable.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: How'd something like that even make it into the Ark?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: The setup's exactly the same as always.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Do you have any idea how blinding those things were today?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... Richard has been with us for three years, and this is his first... mistake.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Fire him. Now.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... Understood.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: And what's with the audience tonight? So lukewarm... Pathetic, every last one of them.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I give them a rare performance like that, and this is the thanks I get?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I'll look into it.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Who's in charge of marketing? Bring them to me.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: He's just stepped out to the restroom for a moment.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Uh!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Didn't I say to wait here until the show's over?!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Am I a joke to you?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: He's been unwell with gastroenteritis for the past few days. I was worried it might get worse if left unattended, so I sent him to the restroom.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: And just who do you think you are?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Who gave you the right to run the show while I'm away?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: That's not the case.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: *Sigh...* Not a single thing meets my standards.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: And it's sweltering in here. AC, now.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Right away.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: So... how are the ratings today?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Un-freaking-believable...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Wasn't it 7% just last week?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Indeed, it was.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: And 12% the week before that.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Why the hell are the ratings still dropping?!

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Our survey shows that the biggest criticism is a lack of novelty...
*Wham!*
Mustang kicks Hanson square in the shin without even standing up.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Do you think that's what I asked for? I told you to come up with solutions, countermeasures!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: And here I am, parading on stage like some miserable clown, blowing kisses for everyone to see. And you... What exactly have you been doing?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hey, Hanson.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Answer me, Director Hanson.
*Wham!*
He kicks Hanson in the shin again.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... I believe the main reason is the lack of new faces.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: The Nikke celebrity project we had invested so much time and effort into...

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: was practically canceled.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: At this point, there's no way for a Nikke celebrity to make an appearance.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: It's all thanks to them royally screwing up that damn surface reclamation war!

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: That seems to be the main reason. Public opinion of Nikkes in the Ark has grown highly hostile,

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: so it's an inopportune time for a Nikke celebrity to step into the spotlight.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Tsk.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hanson, do you have any idea how much I poured into the pockets of those big shots when the Ark was built?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: A lot. A whole damn lot. More than you could even dream of.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: And I kissed every ass I had to, all while spouting some crap about "the good of humanity," just to get my hands on Nikke manufacturing tech.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Why, you ask?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: To secure the monopoly on Nikke entertainment inside the Ark.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Nikkes that don't age, that obey if you fry their brains a little... The perfect product to sell.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I stuffed them with cash, licked their boots,

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: and it worked. Flawlessly.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Then I lured in those pretty-faced, vain, empty-headed Nikkes and molded them into stars.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: All that was left was the debut. One shot, guaranteed hit.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: If everything had gone according to plan, I'd have ruled the Big Three,

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: and literally become the god of the Ark.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: But then...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Those idiots botched the surface reclamation war.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: So tell me, Hanson, what do you do in a situation like that?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... I'll make sure to calm the Nikkes and prepare for the next reclamation war.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Yes! That's exactly it!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Those fools couldn't stomach even a single scratch on their reputations, so they threw the Nikkes under the bus!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: And of course, they had the nerve to officially declare that we lost due to the Nikkes' incompetence. Pathetic!

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: They didn't quite put it that way.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: That's basically what they were saying. The Nikkes didn't live up to expectations...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: so it's not our problem. Go sort them out yourselves. They won't die, they won't break,

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: so have at it.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Yeah, I get it. They had to clean up their mess. Fine.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: But they destroyed my business! The one I poured years into!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: And damn that war... Why start a fight you can't even win?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Uhm...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: At this rate, we're finished. Absolutely finished.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: There's nothing left for us. Nothing!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hanson, fix this. Now.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I'll do my best.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I don't care how you do it. Just get it done.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: My car?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: It's waiting outside.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I'm heading to Ephialtes. Don't even think about looking for me.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... It seems you've been going there quite often lately.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: How else am I supposed to blow off my steam, huh?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I'm leaving.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hey, get me a change of clothes.
Mustang gets to his feet and strides out of the monitor room.
Hanson lets out a deep sigh.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Always working yourself to the bone, huh?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Since you know how hard I've been working, a little help would've been appreciated.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: How exactly am I supposed to help? That person's a nightmare to deal with.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: As I see it, you aren't exactly easy to handle either.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Thanks for the compliment. I almost feel rejuvenated.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: ... Shall we take this outside?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Why are you acting like that? You're scaring me.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: It's important.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Look at this.
Mrs. Miss hands Hanson a document.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: So, she's hoping to become a Nikke... She can't move on her own?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Yeah, she'd already worked her way up to team leader at the Nikke Rights Committee

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: when the Nikkephobes attacked her. Completely severed her nerves, poor thing.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Okay, but what am I supposed to do with her...?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Let's bring her in.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... Pardon?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: A woman who died tragically while campaigning for Nikke rights.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Reborn as a Nikke, she's back to fight for the Goddesses of Victory in her own way.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Quite the picture, huh?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Are you suggesting we bring her into the entertainment industry?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: That I do.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: We don't even know what kind of talent she has...

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: At this point, her story is her talent.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: ... If we play our cards right, it could flip everything in our favor.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... I suppose... that may be true.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: We're doing this, then?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Yes, I'd appreciate it.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Mister.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Phew...

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Yes, it's me.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: I'm so glad I remember everything!

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Yeah, that's a relief.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: So... where was I made?

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Tetra Line.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Tetra Line? Why there of all places?

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: They said the chances of memory retention would be highest there.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Yeah, I think that was a great choice.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: ... How are you holding up?

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: I'm doing great!

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Everything feels totally normal, like I'm still a human.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: ... It's crazy to think that not long ago, I couldn't do anything and was just lying there.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: That won't happen again.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Yeah, looks like I don't have to worry about breaking my neck anymore. Should've done this ages ago.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Freesia,

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: that's enough.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: I've come this far, so I can't stop now, can I?

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Nikkes are managed by the Big Three, but they answer to the Central Government.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: There's no way the government would allow their rights to expand.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: From the government's perspective, the Nikkephobes are useful.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: So you think it's okay to just let it be?

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: There's no helping it.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Hmph. I don't think so.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Now that I'm a Nikke, there's so much more I can do.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: I'll make it happen, no matter what.
*Bzzz*

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: ... Sorry, I'll be right back. I need to take this call.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Sure, go ahead.
*Bzzz*

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: ... Secure line.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Oswald speaking.

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: Chief,

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: I heard your daughter became a Nikke.

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: Does she still have her memories?

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Yes, her memories are intact.

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: Ah, thank goodness.

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: ... And since she's your daughter, I took a quick look at the data, just to make sure everything looked normal.

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: Freesia... she's born to do this.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Born to do what? I'm not sure I follow.

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: Her combat skills are no joke.

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: If I had to exaggerate a bit...

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: that's Liliweiss for you.

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: Ah, of course, she's not quite at Liliweiss's level, but she's close.

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: Honestly, there's nothing stopping her from becoming the next Liliweiss.

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: Chief? You still there?

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: Oh...? Yes, go on.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Could I ask you to alter the data?

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: At this stage, becoming the next Liliweiss wouldn't do any good.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: She'd just be used as propaganda by the Central Government.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: More people would end up dying pointlessly on the surface,

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: and one person alone can't change anything.

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: But Chief, the mere fact that there's a successor to Liliweiss at this point...

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Please, I'm asking for your help.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: I can't let my daughter be sent to the front lines.

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: Pulling the father-daughter card on me, huh? That's a low blow!

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: I apologize.

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: All right, leave it to me. I'll make her look like just another ordinary Nikke.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Would that be possible?

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: Nothing we haven't handled before. Piece of cake.

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: Good thing Enikk's tied up with managing the Ark right now.

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: If everything goes according to plan, we should be able to monitor all sectors by next year.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Right on time.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: I'll leave it in your capable hands.

lines.speaker: specialtask_op
lines.text: Sure thing, guess I'll have to put retirement on hold for a while.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Thank you.
*Click*

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Mister.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Still not done?

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: No, it's over. Why?

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Tetra just called.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: They want me to swing by the office. Apparently, they've got something to tell me.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Tetra?

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: I asked if my guardian could come too, and they said yes! Let's go together!

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: ... What's going on? Why Tetra?

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Why even ask? It's obvious, isn't it?

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Tetra's in the entertainment business, after all.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: They probably saw me and decided to scout me on the spot.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: I don't think that's the case.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: ... Say what?
